correctness.rationale: The fully defined cubic majority map has a self-contained monotone-potential proof of eventual period ≤2. Fixed rungs propagate disagreement, giving an explicit two-bit transfer for aligned rungs and exactly two additional untwisted states; canonical bipartite double cover transforms M²-fixed counts into fixed counts on two disjoint graph copies or a doubled prism according to n+twist parity. A separate complement-twisted no-triple transfer counts full flips. Algebraic Lucas doubling gives all four residue classes and sign. Independent exhaustive state evolution n=3..12 (20 cases) and independent 4/16-state space-time transfer n=3..22 (40 cases) replay exactly. Finite tests corroborate, not replace, proof.

value.rationale: It is an infinite family of nonlinear discrete dynamical classifications on two canonical cubic graph families, determining fixed, immediate two-periodic and fully-flipping populations and a striking sign reversal of the impact of one seam twist according to coprimality with six. The difference grows exponentially although leading populations agree, and all numerical cycle counts become exact formulas. This compares two global topologies of equal size and degree; it is not merely a table recomputation or the known cyclic-word count.
